t: The Bristan Buzz2 rear-fed exposed thermostatic bar mixer shower provides reliable temperature control and versatile showering options. This chrome-plated unit features an adjustable rigid riser with a fixed overhead drenching shower and a multi-function handset, offering 3 x spray patterns for varied user preference. Thermostatic controls ensure a consistent, safe water temperature, making it suitable for family bathrooms or commercial properties. Designed for straightforward installation, it includes all necessary fixings and is compatible with all plumbing systems, from 1 to 5 bar pressure.
